recognize_zh: 流式圖：先以 FSC-H/FSC-A 圈出單一細胞（singlets），再以 FSC/SSC 選出低側向散射的淋巴細胞；橘色 B 細胞群 CD5 陽性、CD10 陰性、CD20 亮陽性、CD38 表現不一，CD5+/CD10- 的 B 細胞需區分被套細胞淋巴瘤與 CLL。
features: FSC-A vs FSC-H singlet gate, followed by an FSC vs SSC gate on small low-SSC cells (orange)
CD5 vs CD10: orange population is CD5 positive and CD10 negative
Grey CD10-positive events (granulocytes) and blue CD5-positive T cells provide internal controls
CD20 vs CD38: orange B cells are CD20 bright with variable, predominantly dim to moderate CD38
Blue CD20-negative T/NK cells separated from the B-cell population
describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plots show doublet exclusion (FSC-A vs FSC-H) and a scatter gate on small cells with low side scatter. The orange-painted B-cell population co-expresses CD5, is negative for CD10, and shows bright CD20 with variable dim to moderate CD38. Internal controls include CD10-positive granulocytes and CD5-positive, CD20-negative T cells. A CD5-positive, CD10-negative, CD20-bright B-cell population favors mantle cell lymphoma over CLL, pending CD23, CD200, light chain and cyclin D1/CCND1 evaluation.

ddx.vs: CLL is CD5+ CD10- but has dim CD20 and is CD23 and CD200 positive.
FL is CD10 positive and CD5 negative.
MZL is typically CD5 and CD10 negative.
HCL shows high side scatter, bright CD11c, CD25, CD103 and CD123, and is usually CD5 negative.
